def: to tread down, i.e. subjugate; specifically, to crumble off
kjv: (come to, make to) have dominion, prevail against, reign, (bear, make to) rule,(-r, over), take.
occ: shall come he that shall have dominion
them, that they shall no more rule
so that they had the dominion
not them that he had taken
they were; and they shall rule
